declarations.description:
A combobox backed by a composed `c2-list` inside `c2-overlay`. As in `c2-virtual-list`, arbitrary objects use
`itemKey`, `labelField`, `descriptionField` and `disabledField`; `renderItem({ item, index, search })` replaces only
the row content, so selection, keyboard behaviour and accessibility remain owned by the surrounding
`c2-list-item`.

Local suggestions are filtered in the browser. `dataSource(query, signal)` delegates matching to a server and is
debounced; every superseded request is aborted. The overlay is structurally a header slot, the list, and a footer
slot, with loading / empty / error states rendered inside the list surface.
declarations.name: Autocomplete

slots.description: Icon or adornment shown before the text input.
slots.name: prefix-icon

slots.description: Icon or adornment shown after the clear button.
slots.name: suffix-icon

slots.description: Replaces the default cross in the clear button.
slots.name: clear-icon

slots.description: Content above the suggestion list, such as filter chips or a result summary.
slots.name: header

slots.description: Content below the suggestion list, such as an “all results” action.
slots.name: footer

slots.description: Replaces the loading message inside the list.
slots.name: loading

slots.description: Replaces the empty-result message inside the list.
slots.name: empty

slots.description: Replaces the remote-source error message inside the list.
slots.name: error

members.name: value
members.description: Current input text and form value. A selection replaces it only when `selectionBehavior` is `replace`.

members.name: name
members.description: Input name used for form submission.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the input is empty.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the combobox input and composed list.

members.name: suggestions
members.description: Local items to search. An array in the property, JSON in the attribute; items may have any structure.

members.name: itemKey
members.description: Field used as a result's stable value. An empty value falls back to a primitive item or its index.

members.name: labelField
members.description: Field used as primary row text. Defaults to `label`, `name`, `title` or `value`.

members.name: descriptionField
members.description: Field used for the optional secondary row line.

members.name: disabledField
members.description: Field whose truthy value makes a row unavailable.

members.name: searchFields
members.description: Fields used by local matching; a `;`-separated attribute or string array property. Defaults to every scalar field.

members.name: matcher
members.description: Custom local matching for arbitrary item structures.

members.name: dataSource
members.description:
Async item provider. It receives the query and an abort signal; server results are not filtered again locally.
Reopening an unchanged query reuses its last successful results; call `load()` to force a refresh.

members.name: renderItem
members.description: Replaces a row's content. The returned content is wrapped in a selectable `c2-list-item`.

members.name: selectionBehavior
members.description: Whether selection preserves the typed query or replaces it with the selected item's key.

members.name: debounce
members.description: Delay before calling `dataSource`, in milliseconds.

members.name: minQueryLength
members.description: Query length required before results are shown or requested.

members.name: maxResults
members.description: Maximum number of results shown after filtering or loading.

members.name: showEmpty
members.description: Keep the result panel open to show an empty state when nothing matches.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the value without allowing edits or opening suggestions.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the control and excludes it from form submission.

members.name: required
members.description: Marks the control required for native form validation.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the suggestion panel is open. May also be controlled programmatically.

members.name: selectedItem
members.description: Original item selected most recently, or `undefined` after the input is edited.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the inner text input.

members.name: load
members.description: Runs local matching or the remote data source immediately, bypassing the debounce.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the result panel and clears keyboard highlighting.

events.name: suggestion-select
events.description: Fired after a row is chosen. The detail contains the selected key, original item and visible index.

events.name: input
events.description: Re-dispatched from the inner input on every edit; also fired after a suggestion replaces the value.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the typed value is committed or a suggestion replaces it.
Fired on every user edit, before local filtering or a remote request.
events.name: query-change
